# AV Detailing

> Premium mobile car, RV, boat, and aircraft detailing in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. Ceramic coating, paint correction, and interior/exterior detailing — we come to you.

Business: AV Detailing LLC, founded by Aaron Vasquez
Website: https://avdetailing.net
Phone: (225) 521-6264
Location: Baton Rouge, Louisiana
Service areas: Baton Rouge, Prairieville, Gonzales, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary, Baker, Brusly, Port Allen, Perkins Road area, Highland Road area, Southdowns, LSU Lakes area, Bocage, Country Club of Louisiana, Mira Vista.

Book online using the website, or call or text (225) 521-6264. We come to the customer's home or office.
Payment methods: cash, credit cards, debit cards, Cash App, Venmo. See booking for the final payable total.
Owner-confirmed trust statement: 110+ five-star Google reviews. See the [Google Maps listing](https://www.google.com/maps?cid=7061043489708478604).
For current prices, read the relevant service pages; prices depend on service and vehicle. RV services are exterior-only.

## Services we don't offer

We are a professional detailing company only, not a repair shop. We do not offer mechanical repair, windshield repair/replacement, body work, paint repair, dent repair, oil changes or tire services.
